question: Does the new discharge protocol delay readmission?

decision_rule.metric: log hazard ratio of readmission, new protocol versus usual care

column_notes.days_followed: days from discharge to readmission, or to the end of the 90-day follow-up when the patient was not readmitted
column_notes.readmitted: 1 = readmitted within the follow-up, 0 = followed for 90 days without readmission
